summary.notes: Oracle and AUM update manipulation incident inventory for Makina Finance. The public incident trail includes the original attacker, the front-running MEV searcher, exploit contracts, the targeted Curve pool, and recovery wallet activity.

contractAddresses.name: OriginalAttackerEOA
contractAddresses.notes: Original attacker address identified by Makina's incident update.

contractAddresses.name: MEVSearcherEOA
contractAddresses.notes: MEV searcher that replicated and front-ran the attack.

contractAddresses.name: ExploitContract
contractAddresses.notes: Delegated execution contract used during the exploit.

contractAddresses.name: DUSDUSDCStableSwapPool
contractAddresses.notes: Curve stable swap pool whose live balances fed the manipulable AUM calculation.

contractAddresses.name: CaliberContract
contractAddresses.notes: Exploited contract exposing the vulnerable accountForPosition path.

contractAddresses.name: MEVBuilderAddress
contractAddresses.notes: Builder address tied to the reordered execution path.

contractAddresses.name: MEVRecipient1
contractAddresses.notes: Primary MEV recipient wallet holding the majority of extracted ETH.

contractAddresses.name: RecoveryWallet
contractAddresses.notes: Recovery wallet named in Makina's on-chain bounty messages.

resolutionStrategy: Use Makina official resources for protocol positioning and developer links
Preserve the split between original attacker and MEV-driven extractors in scenario metadata
Treat the Curve pool and Caliber contract as the minimum onchain dependency set for simulation
